description: This file defines validators for enum types in Kubernetes code generation, including handling of enum and enum exclusion tags, validation logic, and code generation helpers.

classes.name: enumType
classes.description: Represents an enum with a name and a list of enum values.

classes.name: enumValue
classes.description: Represents a single enum value with its name, string value, comment, and exclusions.

classes.name: enumExclude
classes.description: Defines an exclusion rule for enum values based on options.

methods.name: ValueStrings
methods.description: Returns all enum values as sorted, quoted strings.

methods.name: addIfNotPresent
methods.description: Adds a new enum value if it does not already exist, replacing existing if value matches and comment is longer.
